// PROBE for tests/unit/notification-preference-keys.test.ts ("no preference
// surface hardcodes a channel"). A preference writer that restates the channel
// itself — the exact shape of the pre-fix defect, where the settings screen
// wrote `channel: "email"` and a switched-off stream kept firing on push.
// The guard's detector must flag this file on BOTH counts: a channel literal
// at the write site, and no derivation from PREFERENCE_CHANNELS.
export async function optOutOfDigest(db: any, userId: string) {
    await db.notificationPreference.upsert({
        where: {
            userId_eventType_channel: { userId, eventType: "weekly_digest", channel: "email" },
        },
        update: { enabled: false },
        create: { userId, eventType: "weekly_digest", channel: "email", enabled: false },
    })
}
